name: REGENT-4
author: David Ryan
tagline: play chords; four parts follow them
description: REGENT-4 conducts by harmony. White keys play the degrees of the key as chords, black keys colour them (7th, sus2, sus4, add9, 6th, major/minor flip, flat five). A pad voice-leads through the changes, a bass plays one of eight figures from the root, two motifs arpeggiate the chord at their own rates, and a beat runs under it. Record a progression by playing it, let it play back, change key on the fly, and send every part to its own MIDI channel over USB and Bluetooth.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). After the Conductive Labs NDLR and chord-track harmony engines. Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
